appearance_facts.fact: Y-axis label: 'Temperature (°C)' with a scale from 0 to 24, marked at intervals of 5.
X-axis label: 'Year' with tick marks for years 2005 through 2015.
A single blue line connects 11 data points, each marked with a black dot and labeled with its corresponding temperature value in °C.
The first data point is at year 2005 and is labeled '$24.0°C'.
The last data point is at year 2015 and is labeled '$10.0°C'.
The data point for 2010 is labeled '$16.3°C' and is located between the 15 and 20°C grid lines.
The data point for 2012 is labeled '$15.4°C' and is located between the 15 and 20°C grid lines.

public_definitions: Review the 2005-2015 temperature monitoring trend and route the record based on whether the multi-year change warrants follow-up under the substantial trend workflow.
Use the charted yearly temperature readings as the basis for this routing decision.
Routing criterion: Magnitude of change across the review period.
